name: @helpdesk/handoff-core
description: The generic handoff queue-item lifecycle: the record shape, the open/taken/resolved transitions, the required resolution note, and the audit writing. Nothing else: no credential, no policy, no tool schema, no transport, no database connection management. See root README, "Handoff core notes", for what that boundary buys and why this exists as its own package rather than living in @helpdesk/gateway-core (SPRINT4.md, section 2) — its two writers, a gateway's own `hand_off` tool and the orchestrator directly, neither of which should import the other's runtime, the same reasoning that already produced @helpdesk/audit-core.
